spans.s:
शौट् शौट् (also written शौड्), cl. 1. P.
शौटति, शुशौट, शौटितुम्, to be proud
or haughty: Caus. शौटयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अशु-
शौटत्.

शौटीर, अस्, आ, अम्, proud, haughty; (अस्), m. a
hero; a proud or haughty man (but of low tribe or
occupation); an upstart; one who abandons the
world, an ascetic.

शौटीर्य, अम्, n. pride, arrogance; heroism,
prowess.
